source: MARD genre-classification subset from Oramas et al. (2016)
source_license: MIT according to the dataset authors' MARD page and repository; raw reviews stay local
exclusion_reason: the frozen two-or-more-character tokenizer produces no target tokens for this label
heldout_unit: album; artist-disjointness is not verifiable in this subset
candidate_rule: lower endpoint of the descriptive paired ten-fold 95% Student-t interval for target-masked macro AP minus held-out prevalence exceeds zero
negative_controls: two fixed complete-label-set cyclic reassignments, applied independently to each train and held-out fold while preserving per-fold label support
sensitivity_control: fixed per-label synthetic codeword appended to train and held-out text before target masking
diagnostic_reference: exact random-label AP expectation conditioned on each fitted score's tie blocks
provenance_status: Author-recorded local protocol with no independently sealed pre-run record; implementation corrections followed an initial output. Treat as a post-audit external-corpus check, not an independently preregistered test.
scope: independent album-review/genre corpus; not audio quality, listener preference, or proof of a field-standard screening rule
